page_note: 页面上方是IEA《Energy Technology Perspectives 2024》的图1.2（左panel为堆积面积图"Investment"、右panel为折线图"Share of GDP"，共用一个底部图例），下方为"Investment in clean energy technology supply chains"一节正文。

figures.source_line: Sources: IEA analysis based on Oxford Economics Limited (2024a).

components.evidence: left panel "Investment" is six filled bands stacked from 0 to ~6.4 over 2005-2023
"Investment" panel is stacked areas, "Share of GDP" panel is six unfilled lines
bold "Investment" and "Share of GDP" set above each plot
single legend row China ... Rest of World below both panels
legend sits under the two plots, above "IEA. CC BY 4.0."
left axis 0-8 trillion USD, right axis 0%-20%; no reading carries across
"Trillion USD (2023, MER)" set vertically along the left panel's y axis
bare ticks 0, 2, 4, 6, 8 scaled only by "Trillion USD (2023, MER)" axis title
yearly data 2005-2023 but only "2005" and "2023" printed on each x axis
"Sources: IEA analysis based on Oxford Economics Limited (2024a)." under the figure
faint horizontal rules at tick levels in both panels, no vertical rules
6 series x 19 yearly points x 2 panels ≈ 228 plotted points

new_components.name: key_message_line_below_figure
new_components.evidence: bold blue two-line takeaway "Manufacturing investment has risen most rapidly in China ..." below source line
new_components.why_it_matters: 该结论句是图的一部分文字，落在source行之下，解析时若被当作正文会丢失图的语义上下文，也可能被误当作图题。

new_components.name: license_line_below_figure
new_components.evidence: right-aligned "IEA. CC BY 4.0." between legend and the source line
new_components.why_it_matters: 这一行夹在图例与来源之间，容易被解析器当成图注或数值标签，干扰对source行与表头的定位。

new_components.name: unit_in_tick_labels
new_components.evidence: right panel ticks printed as "0%, 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%"; no axis title on that panel
new_components.why_it_matters: 右panel的单位只存在于刻度文字里，读数必须带上%号；表格若只写数字9会与左panel的trillion数混淆。

difficulty_notes: 左panel刻度间距只有0,2,4,6,8五档，1个trillion约35像素；要把United States的0.5读到5%误差即±0.025，等于不到1像素，而且堆积面积图必须用上下两条边界相减才能得到band厚度，边界线本身有1-2像素粗。右panel五档0%-20%，1%约14像素，Japan谷值7.5%的±0.4%容差也仅5像素，且19个年份只有2005与2023两个刻度，年份位置需在两端之间内插，定位误差直接变成数值误差。相比之下标签只需panel名+系列名+年份三级，表格可以承载。
